cmd/kogen-loop/main.go.patch:
diff --git a/cmd/kogen-loop/main.go b/cmd/kogen-loop/main.go
index 5447a41..0e2936c 100644
--- a/cmd/kogen-loop/main.go
+++ b/cmd/kogen-loop/main.go
@@ -64,8 +64,11 @@ func run(args []string, stdin io.Reader, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {
 	case "capabilities":
 		fs := flag.NewFlagSet("capabilities", flag.ContinueOnError)
 		fs.SetOutput(stderr)
-		asJSON := fs.Bool("json", false, "print the capabilities as JSON (the only format; required)")
-		if err := fs.Parse(args[1:]); err != nil || fs.NArg() != 0 || !*asJSON {
+		fs.Bool("json", false, "print the capabilities as JSON (the only format; required)")
+		seen := false
+		err := fs.Parse(args[1:])
+		fs.Visit(func(*flag.Flag) { seen = true })
+		if err != nil || fs.NArg() != 0 || !seen {
 			fmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)
 			return api.ExitInvalid
 		}
